queries.query: Samundri Pakistan cadastral parcel map official land records GIS
queries.result: Found the official Punjab Land Records Authority and PULSE viewer. The viewer source identifies a public Punjab cadastral ArcGIS map service with a Faisalabad sublayer; no separate Samundri local portal was found.

queries.query: سمندری پاکستان نقشہ اراضی ریکارڈ سرکاری
queries.result: Search found official Punjab land-record services and Urdu-language land-record context, but no Samundri-specific Urdu parcel viewer. The English-discovered official PULSE/ArcGIS route was used for bounded map inspection.

localCustodian.name: Punjab Land Records Authority / Punjab PULSE
localCustodian.evidence: The official PULSE viewer configuration points to the Punjab_Cdastral_Maps ArcGIS MapServer and its Faisalabad layer 7; a bounded query returned features whose Tehsil attribute is Samundri. This evidences a provincial cadastral map service covering the city area, not a separately identified municipal registry office.

generalAgency.name: Board of Revenue, Government of Punjab
generalAgency.scope: General provincial land-revenue authority context; not treated as proof of a Samundri-specific public API.

sample.selection: First three returned polygons from a bounded envelope around the WUP point; returned attributes included Tehsil=Samundri and Mouza=140 GB.

runtimeReadiness.reason: A real public source and safe parcel IDs/geometries were evidenced, but runtime admission remains held pending independent serial adapter qualification.
